author: claude
summary: Task 008 (voice-card-consolidation, P7): adds the MediaRecorder/getUserMedia capture UI for VoiceLab's Record mode -- useMicRecorder (state machine: idle/requesting-permission/recording/captured/permission-denied, AnalyserNode RMS-based dBFS level metering, a running timer) and RecordControls (record/stop button, visible meter + timer, full INV-REC-4 accessibility contract). This is genuinely new -- no MediaRecorder/getUserMedia code existed anywhere in this frontend before this task.

files.change: New hook. getUserMedia request -> MediaRecorder lifecycle -> AudioContext/AnalyserNode level metering (RMS over time-domain samples, converted to dBFS, floored at -60dB) -> running elapsedMs timer. start()/stop()/reset() plus full teardown (stream tracks stopped, AudioContext closed, intervals cleared) on unmount.

New component wrapping useMicRecorder. Record/stop button's accessible name (aria-label) changes with state (not just visual icon). Explicit one-shot aria-live announcements for 'Recording started' / 'Recording stopped, N seconds captured' / permission-denied, plus a SEPARATE throttled (2.5s) aria-live channel driven by its own polling interval (not an effect keyed on levelDb, since a sustained near-constant level wouldn't retrigger a value-change effect) that does real silence detection over a rolling window of recent level readings vs a floor threshold. Explicit 'why we need this' explanation rendered before any getUserMedia call (visible in idle/permission-denied). Focus returns to the record button on the record->stopped transition (this task's slice of INV-REC-4 -- task 009 owns the other two transitions, stopped->playback and playback->keep/retake). onKeep/onRetake are accepted per the task's target shape but intentionally unused here (task 009's scope).

Mounts <RecordControls /> below RecordingCueCard in Record mode. Adds a Space-key handler on the record-mode container that clicks the record/stop button via a data-record-toggle-btn selector (covers the container beyond the button's own native Space handling, e.g. right after using the archetype picker); ignored when focus is on a form control. Enter=keep/R=retake are left for task 009 to add to this same keydown surface.

tests_added: frontend/tests/helpers/mediaRecorderMocks.ts (shared MediaRecorder/getUserMedia/AudioContext mocks; jsdom has none of these natively)
deviations: Silence-detection/throttle logic lives in RecordControls's own setInterval reading a ref-mirrored levelDb, not in a useEffect keyed on rec.levelDb as the task file's target-shape sketch implied -- a React-state-change-triggered effect misses ticks where a sustained level doesn't change value, which is both a real correctness risk and unverifiable under fake timers.
